name: Servant of the Unknown (Legendary Druid Archetype)
body:
There are unknown forces in nature with their own goals and their own servants. They call to those who will worship them and empower them in their own unique way.

Skills

The servant of the unknown adds Knowledge (arcana) to their class skill list and removes Diplomacy from their class skill list. This modifies skills.

Circle of Mystery: The servant of the unknown gains a familiar as a witch of equal level. In addition, they may choose a patron. They gain that patron’s spells as spells known. They may choose a special patron if they wish.

This ability replaces druidic circle.

Hexes

The servant of the unknown gains a bonus minor, major, and grand talent at 2nd, 10th, and 18th level, respectively.

Whenever the legendary druid would gain a minor, major, or grand talent, they may choose to gain a minor, major, or grand hex in its place, respectively, if they choose.

Wyrmkin

You have studied dragons and have taken some of their power as your own.

Blessed by Dragons (Ex)

The wyrmkin gains the dragonkin sub-type. It’s not unusual for a wyrmkin to look a little draconic, such as having unusual eyes, sharp nails, small horns, or scaly skin (matching their exemplar dragon).

The wyrmkin must select one type of dragon to be kin to, using its energy type for their abilities.

Red, Brass, Gold: fire

Black, Green, Copper: acid

Blue, Bronze: electricity

White, Silver: cold

This choice cannot be changed later and affects the wyrmkin’s class features, but does temporarily change if the wyrmkin polymorphs into a dragon of a different type.

When the wyrmkin casts a druid spell that does damage of their exemplar dragon’s type, it does additional damage equal to the level of the spell slot used to cast the spell. This is added to every damage roll made by the spell.

Draconic Spells (Ex)

The draconic druid gains the following bonus spells as spells known at the level they become able to cast these spells:

Spells: cause fear (1st), resist energy (2nd), draconic reservoir (3rd), dragon’s breath (4th), polymorph (5th), form of the dragon I (6th), form of the dragon II (7th), form of the dragon III (8th). overwhelming presence (9th).

This replaces druidic circle.

Wyrm Breath (Su)

The wyrmkin gains the ability to channel their draconic might into a breath weapon. This breath weapon

Dracoform (Su)

(Grand Talent)

You may cast any level of form of the dragon at will, without using a spell slot. If you know form of the alien dragon or form of the exotic dragon as druid spells, you may cast these at will without using a spell slot.

Elementary Magic (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

Choose one conjuration or evocation spell with the spell descriptor that matches your exemplar dragon’s damage type.

You gain this as a spell known. This spell does not change if your exemplar dragon changes. You may change this spell whenever you gain a new character level.

Expansive Transformation

(Major Talent)

You may add form of the alien dragonlod and form of the exotic dragonlod to your spell list. When you gain for of the dragon as a known spell, you gain the equivalent level version of these.

Greater Exhalation (Su)

(Major Talent)

The wyrmkin’s breath weapon increases to a 30 ft., cone or a 60 ft., line and adds your Wisdom modifier to the damage it deals.

At 16th level, it again increases to a 45 ft., cone or 90 ft., line.

Natural Arcana (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

You gain Knowledge (arcana) as a class skill.

Pronunciation (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

You may alter the sound of your voice at-will, to make yourself sound more draconic. This works as the spell dragonvoicedsh.

Wings (Su)

(Major Talent)

The wyrmkin can form a spectral pair of wings, granting them a fly speed of 60 ft., with good maneuverability. At 16th level, their flight speed increases to 100 ft., with perfect maneuverability.
